product.description: Enjoy bright and colorful stage lighting using this Flat PAR Stage Light from Monoprice™!              This light uses nine 10‑watt RGBW LEDs with an almost unlimited number of color variations. It can be controlled using basic 8‑channel DMX or using one of the built‑in programs. The Strobe Follow mode allows you to have multiple fixtures strobe in sequence, rather than all at once.
